criteria.assertion: Independently hash and trace five actual request/result projections and every relevant imported DTO, requirement/review/access/flag/document/client/landscape owner. Publish metadata and conclusions only; disclose drift.

Closed operation-specific inputs, canonical inert JSON snapshots, defaults and exact source bounds; no coercion or caller authority. Distinct success/refusal envelopes preserve disabled/denied/unsupported/unavailable truth limits.

Output operation, opportunity/client/query/asOf binding, canonical projection closure and 24000 JavaScript JSON-character ceiling; do not substitute UTF-8 bytes or Unicode code points for source code units.

Search five-row bounds and grant versus contract value semantics preserve actual source projection, counts/partial/truncation and optional/null distinctions; no invented funding amount or absence guarantee.

Requirements page identity/order/cursor/filters/review-status semantics follow actual frozen producer and schema; distinguish extracted content/review assertions from current document access or approval.

Detail and client context preserve policy/client/grant/document prerequisites, source dates/provenance and refusal behavior. Landscape cap40, pre-truncation counts and fingerprint use actual source semantics without invented completeness/currentness.

Hostile accessors/proxies/hidden keys/cycles/nonfinite/oversized data refuse without side effects. Immutable normalization and standalone output assertion scope use canonical admission, no second compiler/authority/producer.

Preserve all original tests/public contracts/locks/catalog and root integration ownership. Retain failures and exact before/after freezes, independently replay meaningful controls with owned cleanup and report exact ACCEPT_SOURCE/HOLD; all runtime/source connectivity unavailable.
